notes.title: Gods of Havoc - Trilogy
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35397735/784fd00bc6fd1e4322fac50b082b368a3687936b.png[/img]

[h1]Gods of Havoc heralds a return to the classic God-Game.[/h1]

Gods of Havoc is a three-part series offering difficult, turn-based strategy. Each game places the player as a god in different eras of a planet’s history.
 
[list]
[*] Fall to Earth: takes place in an early medieval setting;
[*] After the Fall: takes place in a post-apocalyptic one;
[*] Into the Void: takes place in a galactic scale.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1117340/Gods_of_Havoc_Into_the_Void/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120770/Gods_of_Havoc_Fall_to_Earth/
 
‘Fall to Earth’ and ‘Into the Void’, are set to be released in August 2019 with ‘After the Fall’ to be released in December 2019.

Don't forget to wishlist for more news on all three games! Visit https://www.gods-of-havoc.com/ for more information!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 (Balancing)
notes.content:
* Chance of 2x spawning enemies has been reduced at night.
* Chance of finding pistol & shotgun ammo increased.
* Chance of finding flame ammo decreased.
* Chance of 'Death's Portal' opening increased.
* Death's scythe now does more damage.
* Sprinting zombies are now rarer in interiors.
* Time has been slowed slightly.
* Chance of randomly finding keys slightly increased.

---------------------

Also, if you like this game: please consider voting up our latest one on Greenlight! We really appreciate every vote!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=651542337

notes.title: DLC Cheat Pack! - A lazy way to play more characters!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/447300?beta=0

Tired of hunting around the city, trying to find characters to unlock? Then this pack is for you!

This pack will unlock 5 additional starting characters for the game, without you having to locate them first. The characters are:

1. Alice Wazcheck
   A very fit yoga teacher who starts with 20 extra snacks! She begins the game to the far right of the map, near the mayor's mansion.

2. Joan Dartsmith
   A sewage worker who starts in the sewers directly beneath the gunshop, oh yeah! She also gets a sewer access card!

3. Clive Mackersdonger
   Starts with a hospital key-card and just outside the Eastern entrance to the hospital. 

4. Hannah Greatford
   A car mechanic that starts with the fuel siphoner. A great character for crafting as she's never short on fuel!

5. Roger Grubberwick
   Poor old Roger! Not much better than the starting characters but does get a lot of random crafting supplies to start with.

Even with these characters unlocked you still get the fun of locating the last 3, and best, starting characters, although it will be much easier now you have access to new parts of the map! Good Luck!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 [Movement and camera fixes]
notes.content:
1. The 'smooth scrolling' script has been removed. The camera now moves with the player instead of slowly following behind.

2. The character no longer takes a second to turn and move from a stopped position.

3. Strafe has been quickened.
